title: CONFIDE Tier 1 Session Inference Entry
description: One call-ledger entry covering an inference session at session granularity, per CONFIDE/1.0 section 12.1. Written by a session close hook; every claim it carries is what such a hook can honestly supply. A session that used more than one provider writes one entry per provider. Per-call fields a hook cannot honestly supply are absent, never fabricated. The per-call form is inference-call.schema.json and binds at Tier 2.

sessionId.description: The tooling session this entry covers. Where TRACE/1.0 is in effect this is the session anchor's identifier; see anchorId.

harnessId.description: The TRACE/1.0 harness registry identifier, where a registry exists. Null where none does; null MUST mean no registry, never an unregistered harness silently elided.

anchorId.description: Cross-reference to the TRACE session anchor, where anchoring is in effect. Null at Tier 1 where it is not.

providerId.description: The provider record this entry cites. Exactly one per entry.

callsCovered.description: Calls this entry covers. A call is recorded, in the Tier 1 sense, when an entry covers it.

weakestCustodyClass.description: The weakest custody class observed across the covered calls.

evidenceGrade.description: attested for hook-written entries; observed only where a broker wrote the entry, which is a Tier 2 posture.

prevHash.description: Digest of the previous entry in the call-ledger family, or the chain head sentinel (sha256: followed by sixty-four zeros) for the family's first entry, per BLUEPRINT/1.0 section 8.4.

entryHash.description: Digest over the entry's canonical bytes with the entryHash and signature values excluded, per BLUEPRINT/1.0 section 2.3 ledger entry bytes.

sig.description: Computed over the same excluded byte sequence as entryHash, per BLUEPRINT/1.0 section 2.3.
